item.title: Windows POS 1.0.9+19
item.description:
# Windows POS 1.0.9+19
- Parenthesized store-copy upcharges now print prices only when Upcharge Prices is checked. - When unchecked, parenthesized upcharge names and quantities remain on separate lines without prices, including (Belt) and (Starch). - Preserve repair printing, customer-copy behavior, and the locally remembered checkbox setting.
